messages:
Anya Kim: Quick sync: we need to lock owners + dates for postmortem fixes and decide what we put on the status page vs. what we only share on request. Also propose a recurrence-review rule for repeated root causes.

Mira Patel: Owners: TTL enforcement -> @Devon (target 2026-04-02), Autoscale thresholds -> infra (target 2026-03-30). Ops-bot please create tasks.

ops-bot: Tasks created: "TTL enforcement guard" -> Devon Li -> due 1992662400; "Adaptive autoscale thresholds" -> infra -> due 1992547200.

Devon Li: I can draft the TTL fix and unit tests; need 6 business days. Target stands.

CS Bot: CS asks: publish a short status entry in 24h and provide a redacted RCA link. Customers wanting more detail get an expanded sanitized RCA after NDA or legal review.

Mira Patel: Draft status blurb: "Resolved — config regression cleared cache TTLs causing higher latency for ~4% of requests. Reverted change and applied a temporary guard. See redacted RCA link for details." Approve?

Anya Kim: Approve. Note on recurrence: if same root cause appears >2 times in 6 months, trigger a 30-day recurrence review and executive notif. Add to postmortem template.

Mira Patel: Action recap: 1) Devon implements TTL guard by 2026-04-02, 2) infra tweaks autoscale by 2026-03-30, 3) publish redacted RCA link on status page once percent confirmed, 4) add recurrence-review rule to postmortem process. Checkpoint 2026-04-06.

Devon Li: I'll post a draft redacted RCA for CS review by 2026-03-28.
